core_meaning.primary_meaning: Absalom is a Hebrew biblical name (אַבְשָׁלוֹם), traditionally interpreted as “father of peace”; it is not an Arabic lexical name.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Hebrew word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The Hebrew form אַבְשָׁלוֹם is transliterated into Arabic script as أبشالوم in the current record; that is a transcription, not an Arabic lexical form. The traditional interpretation is “father of peace,” not “man of peace.” The historical-bearer claim needs a direct source.
